parked.spanish: En año del yovel este volverán varón a su posesión.

findings.issue: yovel leaves the common noun יוֹבֵל untranslated; common nouns stay Spanish.
הַזֹּאת is feminine singular and agrees with שנת, marking this year; “del yovel este” attaches este to yovel.
Qal 2mp plus singular איש is the man who returns; bare “volverán varón” can be read as an object.

parked.spanish: Y cuando vendieren venta a tu prójimo, o comprar desde mano de tu prójimo, no oprimirán varón a su hermano.

findings.issue: Hiphil jussive 2mp is the prohibition on the addressees; איש is the distributive man and את marks אחיו as the only object. 'oprimirán varón a su hermano' reads bare 'varón' as the one oppressed and 'a su hermano' as a second participant.
אל with hiphil jussive is a prohibition; 'oprimirán' is future indicative and can be read as a prediction.
Qal imperfect 2mp is ustedes address; 'vendieren' is obsolete future subjunctive rather than current 'vendan', without making the sellers a third party.
כי is marked only as a conjunction; 'cuando' selects a temporal sense.

parked.spanish: Y cuando se empobreciere tu hermano y vacilare su mano contigo, y lo fortalecerás, peregrino y residente, y vivirá contigo.

findings.issue: H3588 is only marked as a conjunction and also licenses if/because; «cuando» selects the temporal sense.
בּוֹ is a preposition plus 3ms; «lo» keeps the suffix as a direct object and leaves the preposition unexpressed.
